newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates seesaw to end down.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates seesaw to end down.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates fluctuated widely before ending down on Monday amid excess liquidity, dealers said.
The initial overnight trades were done at five percent, a dealer at KASB & Co said. The rates soon soared and offers were seen at 10 percent, but bids remained stagnant at six percent.
The rates again came down to the level of five percent and most of the day's trades were done in the range of four to six percent, the dealer said.
